Saosin is the debut studio album by American rock band Saosin, released on September 26, 2006 through Capitol Records.
It is the band's second release to feature lead vocalist Cove Reber.
The album is best known for its lead riffs with delays and natural harmonics as a form of creating melodies.
The discography of American rock band Saosin, consists of three studio albums, three extended plays (EPs), 22 singles and 15 music videos.
